title: Serializer lazy-payload shape, key, and diagnostic integrity

threat_model.attacker: An unauthenticated or authenticated peer able to submit a JSON, MessagePack, or CBOR WAMP payload message that reaches lazy argument materialization.
threat_model.precondition: The transport accepts the frame and higher-level code accesses arguments or keyword arguments after envelope deserialization.
threat_model.impact: Valid payloads with more than seven positional arguments failed only when materialized, malformed MessagePack argument errors could reproduce attacker-controlled payload text, malformed JSON keyword arguments were silently dropped, and MessagePack/CBOR non-string keyword keys were coerced to strings. These differences permit availability, diagnostic-confidentiality, and semantic key-confusion failures across serializers.
threat_model.scope: Lazy positional and keyword payload fragments for WAMP payload-bearing messages in the JSON, MessagePack, and CBOR serializers. Envelope arity remains limited to seven fields; argument collection cardinality does not share that envelope limit.

fix.json: Payload attachment now rejects non-list positional arguments and non-string-keyed keyword maps with payload-free FormatException messages. Already-fresh decoded positional lists are assigned directly, while keyword maps use one typed copy whose TypeError is translated without attacker data.
fix.messagepack: Lazy positional arguments are decoded through the payload array decoder instead of the seven-field WAMP envelope parser. Direct single-binary views remain zero-copy. Keyword maps and materialized fallback payloads reject non-string keys and invalid shapes without interpolating decoded values.
fix.cbor: Lazy positional arguments use payload-specific definite/indefinite array decoding instead of the top-level WAMP arity path. Definite and indefinite direct single-binary views remain zero-copy. Keyword maps and materialized fallback payloads reject non-string keys and invalid shapes with payload-free diagnostics.
fix.compatibility: WAMP wire formats and the seven-field message-envelope invariant are unchanged. Valid argument lists may contain any cardinality allowed by the frame, depth, and collection feasibility limits. Valid string-keyed keyword maps preserve their existing values and ordering.
fix.error_contract: Malformed lazy payloads fail closed with FormatException and constant serializer-specific messages that do not contain decoded payload data.

fail_first.frozen_probe_source: The probe ran against detached commit fbd29c37133543ff884721c3cdaba6a098420345 and emitted only booleans and error type names.

coverage: Eight positional arguments materialize successfully through JSON, MessagePack, and CBOR lazy payload paths
Malformed positional and keyword fragments fail with payload-free FormatException messages
MessagePack and CBOR numeric keyword keys fail rather than being stringified
Existing depth, arity, complete-value, integer, and JSON diagnostic boundaries remain covered

methodology.gbit_definition: Encoded frame bytes multiplied by completed deserialize-plus-materialize operations and eight, divided by measured loop time and 1e9; this is an in-memory parser/view rate, not network wire bandwidth.
methodology.investigation_rule: Investigate a candidate median below -5%, or a slower candidate whose observed range does not overlap baseline.
methodology.correctness_rule: Frame size, iteration count, warmup count, and checksum must match between baseline and candidate for every serializer/scenario.
methodology.host: Apple M3 Ultra, 32 physical cores, 512 GiB memory, macOS 26.6.2 build 25G83 arm64, Dart 3.13.1 stable. Timed subprocesses ran serially; unrelated shared-host work was not controlled.

investigation_history: The first full implementation measured JSON arguments_7 at -4.36% and JSON keywords_128 at -2.91%, both with non-overlapping slower ranges. That implementation was not accepted.

Removing an unnecessary positional-list copy and a redundant keyword key scan preserved strict validation. A focused final ABBAAB rerun measured JSON arguments_7 at +0.11487% and JSON keywords_128 at -0.04188%, both with overlapping ranges.

The final complete ABBAAB campaign uses freshly compiled frozen-baseline and final-candidate executables. No scenario triggered the fixed investigation rule; the largest negative median is JSON binary_64k at -0.11578% with overlapping ranges.
performance.interpretation: The final implementation clears the fixed affected-path performance gate on this shared host. Separated positive MessagePack/CBOR ranges are retained as observations, not universal speedup claims. This evidence supports no material regression for measured valid lazy-payload paths, not identical timing, network throughput, or audit-wide performance clearance.

verification.benchmark_artifact_validation: All 72 records contain seven samples; every frame size, iteration count, warmup count, and checksum matches between baseline and candidate.
verification.bin_verify: passed (exit 0; 193 native transport/serializer tests, 140 default and 148 feature-enabled FFI tests, 429 core tests, 118 MCP tests, 526 router tests with one documented legacy skip, 11 remote-auth integrations, 13 focused zero-copy tests, 124 benchmark tests, package/CLI/live MCP smokes, and eight Chrome Dart2Wasm tests)

local_companions.detail: Local Ollama and GLM loopback endpoints are denied with Operation not permitted in this audit environment. No sandbox bypass was attempted; source inspection, frozen fail-first probes, focused and complete serializer tests, static analysis, and alternating AOT benchmarks provide the retained evidence.
